class="article page no-article-survey" sc-render-smart-button="false" itemscope=""> <section class="article-container" data-stats-ve="35"><h1>Share your chats from Gemini Apps</h1><div class="article-content-container"><div class="cc"><p>You can share a Gemini Apps conversation. To do this, create a public link and then share it, like in a messaging app, or post it on your favorite social platforms.</p>

<div><p><strong>Important:</strong></p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>If you choose to share a chat, anyone with the link can read the chat, reshare it with others, and, except for chats created with Gems or for users under the age of 18,<strong> </strong> continue the chat with <a href="/gemini/answer/13594961#gemini_apps" rel="noopener">Gemini Apps</a> on their own.</strong></li>
  <li>Also, do not enter confidential information in your conversations or any data you wouldn’t want a reviewer to see or Google to use to improve our products, services, and machine-learning technologies.</li>
  <li>When you share a chat, remember that you agreed to Google's <a href="https://policies.google.com/terms" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Terms of Service</a>, including the <a href="https://policies.google.com/terms/generative-ai/use-policy" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Prohibited Use Policy</a>. Be sure not to violate others' copyright or privacy rights.</li>
</ul>

<div><p>To use this feature, you must be signed in to Gemini Apps. <a href="/gemini/answer/13278668" rel="noopener">Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>

<gkms-context-selector id="13751512"></gkms-context-selector><h2 id="share_chat">Share a chat</h2>

<p><strong>Important:</strong> When you share a chat, it creates a public link to that chat. Anyone with the link can read the chat, even if you didn’t share the link with them directly. <a href="/gemini/answer/13743730#about_link_creation" rel="noopener">Learn about what happens when you create a public link</a>.</p>

<div class="no-margin"><p>To share a chat on <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>:</p>

<ol>
  <li>Below a response you want to share, click Share&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/QqVZ3ESyW-OTWnmILv3irGUfGmphnn35oCcv4o0W5nsOc8MSu4zr0RRUoY-6TnY9XcA=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/QqVZ3ESyW-OTWnmILv3irGUfGmphnn35oCcv4o0W5nsOc8MSu4zr0RRUoY-6TnY9XcA"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> Share conversation <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/QqVZ3ESyW-OTWnmILv3irGUfGmphnn35oCcv4o0W5nsOc8MSu4zr0RRUoY-6TnY9XcA=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/QqVZ3ESyW-OTWnmILv3irGUfGmphnn35oCcv4o0W5nsOc8MSu4zr0RRUoY-6TnY9XcA">.

    <ul>
      <li>If you create a public link to share a chat, you share the entire conversation.</li>
      <li>
        <div>If you upload an image to a chat and then share the chat, the image is available and downloadable from the shared chat.</div>
      </li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>Choose how you want to share:
    <ul>
      <li><strong>To share the link:</strong> The <code>g.co/gemini/share</code> link is auto-copied. Paste it where you want to share, like in a messaging app, an email draft, or a forum thread.</li>
      <li><strong>To share on an available social platform:</strong> At the bottom, click the social platform and follow the on-screen instructions.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ol>
</div>
<a class="zippy">Share Gem instructions with your chat</a>

<div><p>If you used a Gem in a conversation, you can share that conversation with or without the Gem instructions included.</p>

<p>When you click Share&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/QqVZ3ESyW-OTWnmILv3irGUfGmphnn35oCcv4o0W5nsOc8MSu4zr0RRUoY-6TnY9XcA=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/QqVZ3ESyW-OTWnmILv3irGUfGmphnn35oCcv4o0W5nsOc8MSu4zr0RRUoY-6TnY9XcA">,&nbsp;select what you want to include:</p>

<ul>
  <li>To share the chat without your Gem instructions: Click Share conversation&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/QqVZ3ESyW-OTWnmILv3irGUfGmphnn35oCcv4o0W5nsOc8MSu4zr0RRUoY-6TnY9XcA=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/QqVZ3ESyW-OTWnmILv3irGUfGmphnn35oCcv4o0W5nsOc8MSu4zr0RRUoY-6TnY9XcA">.</li>
  <li>To share the chat and your Gem instructions: Click Share conversation and Gem instructions&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Pwnkf7kO0dqxpvPvUpGTt33VSuRZMgLcc41eC43ayAk4NH3AeYnORu5LFI2TEj4qsnk=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Pwnkf7kO0dqxpvPvUpGTt33VSuRZMgLcc41eC43ayAk4NH3AeYnORu5LFI2TEj4qsnk">.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<h2 id="continue_chat">Continue a chat</h2>

<p><strong>Important:</strong> For now, this feature isn’t available to users under 18.</p>

<p>When you open a public link to someone else’s shared chat, you can continue that chat with Gemini Apps on your own. If your Keep Activity setting is on, the shared chat will be stored in your Gemini Apps Activity. Learn <a href="/gemini/answer/13278892" rel="noopener">how to manage and delete your Gemini Apps activity</a>.</p>

<div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>Click the public link.</li>
  <li>At the bottom, click <strong>Continue this chat</strong>.
    <ul>
      <li>If the chat was created by a user with a Google AI subscription, you can continue it only if you have a Google AI subscription. <a href="/gemini/answer/14517446" rel="noopener">Learn more about Google AI plans</a>.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ol>
</div>

<h2 id="reshare_chat">Reshare a chat</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>Click the public link.</li>
  <li>Near the top, next to the <code>g.co/gemini/share</code> link, click Copy public link <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/R3rajf4zLqVR7rsKlEZA7UOxKS2vVmvnClqoMv89rZ8QhD6OqBvz5s3G1OwpTZSRwXQ=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/R3rajf4zLqVR7rsKlEZA7UOxKS2vVmvnClqoMv89rZ8QhD6OqBvz5s3G1OwpTZSRwXQ">.</li>
  <li>Paste the link where you want to share it, like in a messaging app, an email draft, or a forum thread.</li>
</ol>
</div>

<h2 id="report_chat">Report a shared chat</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>Click the public link.</li>
  <li>Below the headline, click Report <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/eNYCq8yJND24CLz5xejSVwz8dVnbgJ3DAr4oEf8odrUUmgt4_hIZaO4axkVbQ1YevX8=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/eNYCq8yJND24CLz5xejSVwz8dVnbgJ3DAr4oEf8odrUUmgt4_hIZaO4axkVbQ1YevX8">.</li>
</ol>
</div>

<h2 id="remove_link">Delete a public link</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><p>You can delete a public link that you created. <a href="/gemini/answer/13743730#about_link_removal">Learn what happens when you delete a link</a>.</p>

<ol>
  <li>On your computer, go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>At the bottom, click Settings &amp; help <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/O3hGGLsNulJ3JyYQr_nIeh-luEzDbb2loN-zQM-REx-BSXtmcdzcaDI9swMQHyFSlh8=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/O3hGGLsNulJ3JyYQr_nIeh-luEzDbb2loN-zQM-REx-BSXtmcdzcaDI9swMQHyFSlh8"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> Your public links <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ca8dWtVP7O7YnSVVzcV3ZWAUxGA6icNf0z9i0x8WnogmQsVoCSttIJIoI8iaBMYlu2VG=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ca8dWtVP7O7YnSVVzcV3ZWAUxGA6icNf0z9i0x8WnogmQsVoCSttIJIoI8iaBMYlu2VG">.</li>
  <li>At the end of the public link that you want to delete, click Delete public link <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/7PYCHZSfm6oWdi0hG_buz9GxD53qeLE8_Okj6CJoX1-E4hFi3rRvNexDVkqO62ci9g=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/7PYCHZSfm6oWdi0hG_buz9GxD53qeLE8_Okj6CJoX1-E4hFi3rRvNexDVkqO62ci9g">.</li>
</ol>
</div>

<p><strong>Tip:</strong> To delete all your public links, click <strong>Delete all links</strong>.</p>

<div class="no-margin"><a class="btn btn-raised" href="https://gemini.google.com/sharing" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Manage your public links</a></div>


<h2 id="about_link_creation">What happens when you create a public link</h2>

<div><ul>
  <li>A shared chat page with a public link is created. For example, <code>g.co/gemini/share/abcxyz</code>.</li>
  <li>The shared chat will include any AI-generated artifacts from the conversation, including Canvas documents, images, and videos.</li>
  <li>We don’t add your name or account to the URL address or the shared chat page.</li>
  <li>The shared chat page shows the chat as it appeared when you created the public link. If you edit or continue the chat after you create a public link, the content on the shared chat page won’t change.</li>
  <li>If you share a chat that was created with Gems, the Gem name will be included with the chat. You can choose to also include the instructions used to create the Gem. <a href="/gemini/answer/15146780" rel="noopener">Learn more about Gems in Gemini Apps</a>.</li>
  <li>Anyone with the link can:
    <ul>
      <li>Read the chat, even if you didn’t share the link with them directly.</li>
      <li>Reshare the chat.</li>
      <li>Continue the chat with Gemini Apps on their own (except for a chat that was created with Gems or for users under the age of 18). If their Keep Activity setting is on, the chat is stored in their Gemini Apps Activity with their Google Account.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ul>
</div>

<h2 id="about_link_removal">What happens when you delete a public link</h2>

<div><p>If you delete a public link:</p>

<ul>
  <li>Anyone who tries to access the link will get a message that the chat no longer exists and will be redirected to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>It doesn't delete any posts with the link that you've made on third-party sites. To delete the post, delete it from the third party site.</li>
  <li>It doesn’t delete the chat from your Gemini Apps activity. Learn <a href="/gemini/answer/13278892" rel="noopener">how to manage &amp; delete your Gemini Apps activity</a>.</li>
  <li>It doesn’t delete the chat from other’s Gemini Apps activity if they continue your shared chat in Gemini Apps on their own.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<h2>Fix or report a problem</h2>
<a class="zippy">You can't share a conversation</a>

<div>
  <p><strong>Important:</strong></p>

  <div><p>To use this feature, you must be signed in to Gemini Apps. <a href="/gemini/answer/13278668" rel="noopener">Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps</a>.</p>
</div>

  <p>If you don’t find the Share&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/QqVZ3ESyW-OTWnmILv3irGUfGmphnn35oCcv4o0W5nsOc8MSu4zr0RRUoY-6TnY9XcA=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/QqVZ3ESyW-OTWnmILv3irGUfGmphnn35oCcv4o0W5nsOc8MSu4zr0RRUoY-6TnY9XcA">&nbsp;option, you may not be able to share the conversation because&nbsp;your organization has disabled conversation sharing.<strong>&nbsp;</strong>Your Workspace administrator can turn conversation&nbsp;sharing on or off. Contact your administrator to learn more.</p>
</div>
<a class="zippy">Your public links are deleted</a>

<div><p>Your links are publicly available for as long as the associated chat is saved in your Gemini Apps Activity. If any part of a chat in a public link is deleted earlier, the public link is also deleted. Part of a chat could be deleted in these ways:</p>

<ul>
  <li>You manually delete it from your&nbsp;<a href="https://myactivity.google.com/product/gemini?utm_source=help" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Gemini Apps Activity</a>.</li>
  <li>It’s automatically deleted from your&nbsp;<a href="https://myactivity.google.com/product/gemini?utm_source=help" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Gemini Apps Activity</a>.</li>
  <li>You delete it from your pinned and recent chats.</li>
</ul>

<p>Learn how to <a href="/gemini/answer/13278892#delete_activity" rel="noopener">delete your Gemini Apps activity</a>, <a href="/gemini/answer/13278892#auto_delete" rel="noopener">change your Auto-delete settings</a>, and <a href="/gemini/answer/13666746#delete" rel="noopener">delete pinned and recent chats in Gemini Apps</a>.</p>
</div>

<h2 id="resources">Related resources</h2>

<div><ul>
  <li><a href="/gemini/answer/13275745" rel="noopener">Use Gemini Apps</a></li>
  <li><a href="/gemini/answer/13594961" rel="noopener">Gemini Apps Privacy Hub</a></li>
  <li><a href="/gemini/answer/14184041" rel="noopener">Export responses from Gemini Apps</a></li>
</ul>
</div>
